divisions.name: West Kingston No. 2
divisions.note: The candidates' votes add up to 3,663; with the 43 rejected ballots that makes 3,706, against the 3,705 total votes the report prints. The figures are stored as printed. The printed shares of 52.24, 46.01 and 0.59 per cent fit a total of 3,706. The report prints that Mavis Treasure withdrew; no votes are stored for that candidate.
